hook: Frontier AI labs just signed their first unified safety pact.
spoken_script: Frontier AI labs just signed their first unified safety pact. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, and Microsoft formed SAFA—the Standards Authority for Frontier AI. SAFA establishes mandatory pre-deployment testing for autonomous agents, setting binding thresholds on deception and unauthorized replication. Labs will also share real-time telemetry on emergent vulnerabilities before public rollout. Follow AI News Factory for daily verified AI breakthroughs.
